rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: This Snyk CLI implementation provides security vulnerability scanning and monitoring for applications and infrastructure. Built with TypeScript and Go, it offers a comprehensive command-line interface for testing code, containers, and Infrastructure as Code files for known security issues, generating SBOMs, and continuously monitoring projects on the Snyk platform. The implementation supports multiple package managers and languages, integrates with CI/CD pipelines, and includes both legacy JavaScript and modern Go components with a proxy-based architecture for seamless operation across different environments.
